# Postprocessing

```{python}
import numpy as np

from majordome import (
    FoamPostProcessingLoader,
    FoamLagrangianTable,
    plot_xy,
)
```

```{python}
def bound_percentile(y, pct, vmin=0.0):
    """ Bound a value within a percentile range. """
    return np.clip(y, vmin, np.percentile(y, pct))
```

```{python}
loader = FoamPostProcessingLoader(root="../model")
df = loader.load_report("lagrangian", loader=FoamLagrangianTable, n_last=1)
df.describe().T
```

```{python}
y = bound_percentile(df["T"], 95)

p = plot_xy()
p.axes[0].hist(y, bins=10, edgecolor="k", alpha=0.7)
p.xlabel("Temperature [K]")
p.ylabel("Frequency")
```

```{python}
y = bound_percentile(df["age"], 95)

p = plot_xy()
p.axes[0].hist(y, bins=10, edgecolor="k", alpha=0.7)
p.xlabel("Age [s]")
p.ylabel("Frequency")
```
